memory_candidates.content: When a plan's later phase targets a specific named constant/site for a mechanical edit (e.g. 'refresh BIMODAL_LOGIC_COMMIT'), re-probe that the site still exists immediately before editing even if an earlier phase already re-read the file -- a concurrent sibling task can land a change (including deleting the exact target) between phases of the same dispatch. Treat the pre-edit-gate contract's 'probe before edit' as applying per-edit, not per-phase-open.
